2117181338847744479.en_summary: Base's Jesse Pollak says his AI agents now handle all his bookkeeping, accounting, budgeting, investment updates, trading on Coinbase, and yield access that he previously lacked time for. He sees agentic payments emerging in 2026 and agentic finance in 2027, with growth on Base still small but expanding.
2117181338847744479.zh_summary: Base的Jesse Pollak表示，他的AI代理現在處理他所有的簿記、會計、預算、投資更新、在Coinbase上交易以及他以前沒有時間獲取的收益。他認為代理支付將於2026年出現，代理金融將於2027年出現，Base上的增長仍然很小但正在擴大。

2117169065085083746.en_summary: In the Netherlands, employers must continue paying sick employees for 728 days, nearly two years, compared to 77 days in Luxembourg, a gap of 651 days. This puts Dutch companies at a significant competitive disadvantage.
2117169065085083746.zh_summary: 在荷蘭，僱主必須繼續支付病假員工728天工資，近兩年，而盧森堡只有77天，差距651天。這使荷蘭公司處於巨大的競爭劣勢。

2117167654511526241.en_summary: Palmer Luckey asks what if he wants to use the RAM to do things prohibited by the terms of service of whoever is running the datacenter.
2117167654511526241.zh_summary: Palmer Luckey問，如果他想用RAM做數據中心運營者服務條款禁止的事情怎麼辦。

2117166054250324218.en_summary: Base's Jesse Pollak says crypto mainstream adoption means less than 1% of the world's dollars and equities are onchain so far, with clear product-market fit and growth but not yet pumping bags. He expects the share to rise from under 1% to 10%, 50%, 90% over the next 5-10 years as major financial companies adopt for faster, cheaper services.
2117166054250324218.zh_summary: Base的Jesse Pollak表示，加密主流採用意味著迄今為止世界上少於1%的美元和股票在鏈上，產品市場契合度和增長明顯但尚未推高持倉。他預計隨著大型金融公司為更快更便宜的服務而採用，份額將在未來5-10年內從不足1%上升到10%、50%、90%。

2117164142377263502.en_summary: Lyn Alden replies that the person killed civilians too, notes the main character in her book killed many but not purposely children, and promotes her book Stolguard Incident.
2117164142377263502.zh_summary: Lyn Alden回覆說那個人也殺了平民，指出她書中的主角殺了很多人但沒有故意殺兒童，並推廣她的書《Stolguard Incident》。
